text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Boss!! I'll go ahead and wash this big pot 
over here~!

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Manager
text_block_list.text:
Ehhー!? It's heavy, so you really 
shouldn't!

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Manager
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, doing delivery work or 
something that builds leg strength would 
be much better for Fuu, wouldn't it?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"Nope. Total opposite! Right now, I want 
to work on my upper body."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Trainer told me that my lower body is way 
too strong.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"So apparently, I easily lose my balance 
whenever I run. So I gotta train my upper 
body first~!"

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Manager
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... Fuu's Trainer is as earnest as 
ever, huh...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Right~? You can praise me even more, you 
know! You're my Trainer, after all!

In the morning, while Ines Fujin is away 
at her part-time job, I organize documents 
and draft a training plan for the 
afternoon.

The power in her hindquarters is too 
strong. Off to the gym for five sets of 
planks. First, I need to design a 
core-strengthening routine……
(Whooosh...)

Gazing out the window, cherry blossoms 
were in bloom. The seasons shift unnoticed 
by anyone.
...Even in places I know nothing about.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
...Grandmother. I have something to 
discuss with you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Matriarch
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I figured it was about time you 
arrived.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Matriarch
text_block_list.text:
Tell me, Ryan. Show me the path you intend 
to take.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Ryan-san, congratulations on your splendid 
3-race winning streak! I feel like you've 
really leveled up your power lately!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
You could say she's starting to show that 
distinct Mejiro elegance! Did something 
happen to bring this about?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: ...The poise of the Mejiro family, is it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"I don't have that yet. I'm just a 
fledgling Umamusume who's only barely 
started running."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Possessing true presence means having an 
unshakable pride worthy of your house."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"I've known an Umamusume who embodies that 
for a very long time. I've seen all the 
effort she put in to become that way, and 
all her setbacks, too."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: That made me feel ashamed of myself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Knowing full well that I could never 
become like her— ……yet still clinging 
desperately to the Mejiro name.

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes... Though none of us could possibly 
imagine anything Ryan-san would have to be 
ashamed of...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"...They are kind people, aren't they? But 
don't you think it's pathetic? A name 
isn't something to cling to; it's 
something to carry on your shoulders."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
If I just sit hugging my knees, moping 
that I can't do it... my back will stay 
hunched over and small forever.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"...So, watching that race made me think! 
I need to give it my all without holding 
back!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Even if it's reckless, as long as you're 
running, you're aware that you're moving 
forward. Your head might even naturally 
start to lift up.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"If I do that, someday I'll be able to 
puff out my chest. I'll be able to stand 
tall with pride!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to become tougher! I might be 
unreliable right now, but someday I want 
to have a back strong enough to carry 
everything.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
—That's another reason why I want to win, 
and why I'll keep reaching out my hand 
forward!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Matriarch
text_block_list.text:
Yes. That is fine, Ryan. Before striving 
to be a true Mejiro, you must first grow 
as your own person.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Matriarch
text_block_list.text: ...I have high hopes for you.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"Mejiro Ryan sets her sights on the 
Satsuki Sho!" As expected of Ryan-chan, 
she's getting so much attention~!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: By the way, about today...

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Ines Fuujin... She looks like she's grown 
even more robust over the winter.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
"Looks like you've mostly shed that 
awkwardness in your running style. You're 
practically guaranteed to be the race 
favorite next time, aren't you?"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"I kind of feel like I'm the center of 
attention too, though...?"
choice_data_list: Because the Satsuki Sho is drawing near.

text_block_list.text:
Given her results in the Asahi Hai FS, 
it's only natural that expectations are 
high for her in the first leg of the 
Classic Triple Crown.
choice_data_list:
I think the Satsuki Sho will have a 
totally different atmosphere from the 
Asahi Hai.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Hmm.
choice_data_list:
And with that, let's make sure to get 
plenty of rest!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Waaah! Trainer became even more of a 
worrywart~!!

Even if you say that, I can't forget the 
sight of her collapsed on the turf after 
the Asahi Hai FS.

If she's the type to burn through all her 
gas in a single race, then we should make 
sure her tank is completely full before 
every race.
choice_data_list:
Because I want you to enjoy the best race 
possible!
I want you to enjoy the greatest race!

text_block_list.text:
Injury-free, at full power. All to savor 
this once-in-a-lifetime race with every 
fiber of my being.

—Is the reason I wish for this simply 
because I've always watched her run races 
with more pure joy than anyone else?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu. "I want you to have fun," huh.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
You have an even more excited smile than 
anyone, Trainer. ...Your eyes are 
sparkling just like a kid's.

text_block_list.name: Convenience Store Manager
text_block_list.text:
Heeey, part-timers! The delivery's here~! 
Help unload and stock the shelves, 
please~!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Huh~, a "Classic Triple Crown Bento," it 
says. "Eat this, and you too will have the 
heart of a Triple Crown horse girl..." 
huh.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it really is quite a festival. The 
Triple Crown, that is...

text_block_list.name: Part-Time Gal
text_block_list.text:
Ah. The Satsuki Sho is won by the fastest 
Umamusume, the Derby by the luckiest, and 
the Kikuka Sho by the strongest, right?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Y-Yeah. That's right, but how did 
you know?

text_block_list.name: Part-Time Gal
text_block_list.text:
Well... isn't that just common sense? Or 
rather, obvious enough that even I'd know?

text_block_list.name: False-Eyelash Gal
text_block_list.text:
"Bullcrap. I literally just taught you 
that the other day."

text_block_list.name: False-Eyelash Gal
text_block_list.text:
Actually, you know... We went to watch 
Ines's race the other day. What was it 
called... Asa, a...? Asameshi...?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
The Asahi Hai FS!? All the way in 
Hanshin!?

text_block_list.name: Part-Time Gal
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, exactly! It was seriously insane. 
Like, honestly, how do I even put it...

text_block_list.name: Convenience Store Manager
text_block_list.text:
Heeey, you part-timers~! Move those legs a 
little more briskly, would ya?!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Let's talk more later! I want to 
properly thank everyone for cheering for 
me!
(Whooosh...!)

text_block_list.name: Part-Time Gal
text_block_list.text:
Man... Ines really is super fast after 
all...

text_block_list.name: False-Eyelash Gal
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, you. Who did you name in that 
street survey the other day? You know, for 
the Umamusume most likely to win the 
Satsuki Sho?

text_block_list.name: Part-Time Gal
text_block_list.text: ...Naturally, it's gotta be Ines.

text_block_list.name: Part-Time Gal
text_block_list.text:
"I mean, Ines looks like she could win 
even on the biggest stages, right? ...Or 
rather, I guess I just really want her to 
win."

text_block_list.name: Part-Time Gal
text_block_list.text:
If I get to see her win, it'll totally 
fire me up like, "I won't lose either, 
time to give it my all!"
